context: A small visit. Sachiko has pulled out an old bracelet that was her own grandmother's. Hina is on the floor; Yumiko nearby.
purpose: three-speaker heirloom moment — three generations, one object

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.style: A small careful holding-out. Voice soft.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A real small wonder — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さん…これ、まだ持ってたの。
lines.style: A small voice catching half a step.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。私の、おばあちゃんから。
lines.style: A small slow line. Real weight.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A real kid-astonishment — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当に古い。百年くらい。
lines.en: Truly old. About a hundred years.
lines.style: A small precise marvel — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A real silent beat. The kid actually processing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さん、ありがとう…見せてくれて。
lines.en: Mom — thank you for showing it.
lines.style: A real catch. Voice quieter — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、将来、これ、大切にしてね。
lines.en: Hina-chan — in future, take care of this.
lines.style: A small careful transmission. Voice slow.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A small full kid-commitment — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ありがとう、ひなちゃん。本当に。
lines.style: A real catch in the voice. Three generations bridged.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 一緒に、しまっておこう。大切な場所に。
lines.en: Let's put it away together. In a special place.
lines.style: A small practical closing — voice carries the moment fully.
